The code is still buggy. I downloaded all revisions and tested them. The latest working revision is r7. Revisions r8 through r19 are not working properly. Try the following example:

source("nls2.R")
x=1:100
y=3*exp(x/100)+0.1
w=sqrt(x)
a1=nls(y~a*exp(x/b), start=list(a=3,b=100), trace=TRUE)
b1=nls(y~a*exp(x/b), start=list(a=3,b=100), trace=TRUE, weights=w)
a2=nls2(y~a*exp(x/b), start=list(a=3,b=100), trace=TRUE)
b2=nls2(y~a*exp(x/b), start=list(a=3,b=100), trace=TRUE, weights=w)

messages.author: 9eb2d81b647f7864
messages.subject: Re: nls2: weights not applied?
parts:
I think I found out what is wrong with r19. The following patch seems to make it work:

--- nls2.r19.R 2013-12-16 08:33:25.202478903 -0200
+++ nls2.R 2013-12-16 10:03:34.700004929 -0200
@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@
L <- list(formula = formula, data = data, control = control, trace = trace)
if (!missing(start)) {
co <- try(coef(start), silent = TRUE)
- if (!inherits(co, "try-error")) {
+ if (!inherits(co, "try-error") && !is.null(co)) {
start <- co
# remove names beginning with dot (generated by plinear)
start <- start[grep("^[^.]", names(start))]
